I have a complete map. Here are my findings.

## Summary of the key gap

There is a significant mismatch between the acceptance test's expectation and the current implementation. The test (`AcceptanceTest.java`) expects an "identity-key-v2": `identityKey = SHA-256 hex over (normalizedTelephone | lowerEmail | soundex(lastName))` producing a 64-hex string, with 409 duplicate detection keyed on that full identity. The current code does NOT do this: `identityKey` is a plain pipe-delimited string using `householdId` (not soundex, not hashed), and the 409 duplicate check is household-based AND is not even wired into the create pipeline. `soundex` appears nowhere in `src/main`. Details below.

---

## 1. identityKey computation

- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/OwnerIdentityKey.java` — the whole file. `of(Owner)` and `of(telephone, email, householdId)`. Current key (lines 30-35) is a plain string, NOT hashed:
```java
String tel = OwnerTelephone.canonical(telephone);
String mail = (email == null || email.isBlank()) ? "" : email.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
String household = (householdId == null) ? "" : householdId;
return tel + "|" + mail + "|" + household;
```
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/common/Sha256.java` — shared SHA-256 helper. `hex(String)` (full lower-case 64-hex, lines 23-36) and `hexPrefix(String, int)` (upper-hex prefix, lines 39-41). The `hex` method is exactly what a v2 identityKey would call, but nothing currently calls `hex` (only `hexPrefix` is used, by household + customerCode).
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/mapper/OwnerMapper.java` lines 43-44 — maps the DTO `identityKey` field via `OwnerIdentityKey.of(owner)`.
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/openapi.yml` lines 2169-2174 — `identityKey` schema, documented as `'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId'` with 409-on-whole-key-collision, example `'+61412345678||A1B2C3D4E5F6'` (i.e. plain string, not 64-hex).

## 2. Duplicate detection returning HTTP 409

- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/EnsureUniqueOwnerIdentity.java` — the function that would throw the 409. Currently household-based (uses `OwnerHousehold.idFor(lastName, postcode)`, lines 32-43), skips soft-deleted and `sharesHousehold` requests. IMPORTANT: this class is NOT wired into any OfficeFloor YAML flow — `grep` finds it only in Javadoc references, never in a `.yml`. So the 409 path is currently dead code (see owners.POST.yml below, which explicitly removed the reject step).
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/DuplicateOwnerIdentityException.java` — the exception (extends Exception), message references household.
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/escalation/DuplicateOwnerIdentityExceptionHandler.java` lines 14-18 — sends `HttpStatus.CONFLICT` (409) with body `{"errors":["identityKey"]}`.
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/officefloor/escalation/org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.DuplicateOwnerIdentityException.yml` — registers the handler.
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/officefloor/rest/api/owners.POST.yml` — the create pipeline. Note lines 26-28 comment states the household-reject was deliberately removed ("rather than rejecting a second household member..."). There is NO `ensureUnique`/duplicate step in the pipeline. Steps run: checkIdempotency → validate → ensureCityCapacity → ensureDailyCreateLimit → build → assignCustomerCode → assignHousehold → assignNamesakeCount → save → recordIdempotency → audit → warn → householdSize → membershipLevel → possibleDuplicate → respond.

## 3. householdId computation and household-duplicate detection

- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/OwnerHousehold.java` — the whole file. `idFor(lastName, postcode)` returns null when no postcode (lines 28-33); `id(...)` = `Sha256.hexPrefix(normalizedLastName + "|" + postcode, 12)` (line 37, 12 upper-hex chars); `normalizeName` lower-cases + collapses whitespace (lines 41-46).
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/AssignOwnerHousehold.java` line 21 — stamps `householdId` onto a new owner. Wired as `assignHousehold` in owners.POST.yml (line 59).
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/AssignOwnerHouseholdSize.java` lines 19-29 — computes transient `householdSize` (count of owners sharing householdId). Wired in both owners.POST.yml (line 100) and `{ownerId}.GET.yml` (line 18).
- Household-duplicate 409 logic lives in `EnsureUniqueOwnerIdentity.java` (see item 2, unwired).
- Model: `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/Owner.java` — `householdId` field lines 75-76 (persisted, `@Column household_id`), getter/setter lines 220-225; transient `householdSize` lines 96-102, getter/setter 252-257.
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/openapi.yml` lines 2163-2168 — `householdId` schema (first 12 hex of SHA-256 over normalized last name + postcode).
- `sharesHousehold` request flag documented at openapi.yml lines 2086-2088; consumed in `EnsureUniqueOwnerIdentity` line 29 and `AssignOwnerPossibleDuplicate`.

## 4. soundex usage on lastName

- NOT present in `src/main` anywhere. The only occurrence of "soundex" is the test spec comment: `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/acceptance/AcceptanceTest.java` lines 9-11, which specifies the intended v2 key uses `soundex(lastName)`. This is a feature to be implemented; no soundex helper class currently exists (checked `common/` — no Soundex.java).

## 5. Email-domain blocklist

- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/OwnerEmail.java` — `BLOCKED_DOMAINS` set lines 20-22 (`mailinator.com`, `tempmail.com`, `guerrillamail.com`); `normalize` validates syntax + checks domain against blocklist (lines 37-45), throws `DisposableOwnerEmailException` on a blocked domain (line 43).   govern: [ transaction ]
  next: ensureCityCapacity

# Joining an existing household is now permitted (owners sharing a lastName + postcode
# automatically share a householdId); rather than rejecting a second household member, the
# new member's membershipLevel is capped later (see the 'membershipLevel' step).

# Reject creating an owner when the request's city already contains 50 or more owners,
# responding 409.
ensureCityCapacity:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.EnsureCityCapacity
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: ensureDailyCreateLimit

# Reject creating an owner once 100 or more owners have already been created today
# (by registrationDate), responding 429.
ensureDailyCreateLimit:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.EnsureDailyCreateLimit
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: build

build:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.BuildOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignCustomerCode

# Assign the '<REGION>-<HASH8>' customerCode: REGION is the region derived from the
# postcode and HASH8 is the first 8 upper-hex chars of SHA-256(normalizedTelephone +
# lastName). A stable identity with no sequence number.
assignCustomerCode:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignOwnerCustomerCode
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignHousehold

# Stamp the deterministic householdId (first 12 hex of SHA-256 of normalizedLastName|postcode)
# so owners with the same lastName + postcode share it automatically. Null when no postcode.
assignHousehold:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignOwnerHousehold
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignNamesakeCount

# Count existing owners (before this create) sharing the same firstName + lastName
# (case-insensitive) and record it as namesakeCount before Save.
assignNamesakeCount:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignOwnerNamesakeCount
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: save

save:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.SaveOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: recordIdempotency

# Record the new owner against its 'Idempotency-Key' (if any) so a later repeat with the
# same key returns this owner instead of creating a duplicate. Runs after Save so the id exists.
recordIdempotency:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RecordIdempotentCreate
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: audit

# Emit an AUDIT log line carrying the owner id, customerCode and registrationDate.
audit:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AuditOwnerCreated
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: warn

# Flag whether more than 80 owners were created for this owner's registration day. Runs
# after Save so the new owner is counted, matching what a later GET recomputes.
warn:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignOwnerBulkSignupWarning
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: householdSize

# Record the owner's household size (owners sharing its householdId, including itself).
# Runs after Save so the new owner is counted, driving the 'GOLD' tier (3+ members) and
# matching what a later GET recomputes.
householdSize:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignOwnerHouseholdSize
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: membershipLevel

# Cap the owner's membershipLevel at one above the current maximum among the other members of
# its household. Runs after householdSize (the level depends on it) so the capped value matches
# what a later GET recomputes.
membershipLevel:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignOwnerMembershipLevel
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: possibleDuplicate

# Flag whether this owner soft-matches an existing owner's lastName + postcode with a
# different telephone (not a hard duplicate). Runs after Save so the same value is
# recomputed by a later GET; records possibleDuplicate and possibleDuplicateOf.
possibleDuplicate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignOwnerPossibleDuplicate
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: respond

respond:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RespondWithOwnerCreated
  govern: [ transaction ]

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The optional honorific title of the pet owner. When supplied it drives the derived salutation. One of MR, MRS, MS or DR.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner. When structured address fields are supplied, this is the composed address (the normalized addressLine1, with a single space and the normalized addressLine2 appended when addressLine2 is present); otherwise it is the normalized flat address. Accepted on input for backward compatibility.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: The first line of the owner's structured postal address. Preferred over the flat address when present. Normalized like address.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: The optional second line of the owner's structured postal address. Normalized like address and, when present, appended to addressLine1 (single space) to form the composed address.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Unit 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. Stored and returned in E.164 form.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^\+?[0-9 ()\-]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: The 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. Optional. When supplied it must be valid for the city's region via a fixed table (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          minLength: 4
          maxLength: 4
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered. Defaults to the server's current date when not supplied. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The date of birth of the pet owner. Optional. When supplied, drives the derived ageBand, which is computed as the owner's age on the registrationDate. ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allow creating this owner even if another owner is already in the same household (the same last name and postcode). It only bypasses the duplicate block — the shared householdId is assigned automatically and deterministically regardless of this flag. A declared household member created this way is not flagged as a possible duplicate. Request-only override; never returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: The owner's salutation, formatted as the title, a single space, then the lastName when a title was supplied; otherwise just the lastName.
              type: string
              example: 'DR who'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans as the country code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes. The raw telephone stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: The owner's customer code formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>' where REGION is the region code derived from the owner's postcode and HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex characters of the SHA-256 digest over the normalized (E.164) telephone concatenated with the lastName. A stable identity carrying no sequence number.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: The Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits of the customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 5
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: The fiscal year of the business-day-adjusted registrationDate, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the fiscal year. The fiscal year starts on 1 July and is named by the calendar year in which it ends (so a registrationDate on or after 1 July belongs to the next calendar year's fiscal year). Absent when there is no registrationDate.
              type: string
              example: 'FY27'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: The owner's membership number formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the fiscal year of the registrationDate (the fiscal year starts on 1 July). Derived from the owner's customerCode and registrationDate.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M27'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A stable identifier for the owner's household, computed deterministically as the first 12 hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized last name and the postcode. Owners with the same last name and postcode share it automatically, regardless of creation order. Absent for owners with no postcode.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: The single derived duplicate-detection key, the full lower-case SHA-256 hex digest over 'normalizedTelephone|lowerEmail|soundex(lastName)' (the email is empty when absent). Creation is rejected with 409 only when a new owner's whole identityKey equals an existing (non-deleted) owner's.
              type: string
              example: '9f86d081884c7d659a2feaa0c55ad015a3bf4f1b2b0b822cd15d6c15b0f00a08'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners (before this owner was created) sharing the same firstName and lastName, compared case-insensitively.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: The owner's membership points. Starts at 0, gains 2 when an email is present, gains 1 when namesakeCount is 0, gains 2 for a household of three or more members, and gains 3 for a tenure of more than one elapsed fiscal year (the fiscal year starts on 1 July).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The owner's numeric membership level, from 1 to 4, derived from membershipPoints - level 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3 points, 3 for 4-5 points and 4 for 6 or more points.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The canonical region for the owner, taken from the REGION component of the customerCode (the '<REGION>-<HASH8>' identity), i.e. the region derived from the owner's postcode, or 'UNKNOWN' when no region applies.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: The IANA timezone for the owner's locality, from the fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the locality has no mapped timezone (i.e. 'UNKNOWN').
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners share this owner's registration date (i.e. more than 80 owners were created for that business day), otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors

          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The optional honorific title of the pet owner. When supplied it drives the derived salutation. One of MR, MRS, MS or DR.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner. When structured address fields are supplied, this is the composed address (the normalized addressLine1, with a single space and the normalized addressLine2 appended when addressLine2 is present); otherwise it is the normalized flat address. Accepted on input for backward compatibility.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: The first line of the owner's structured postal address. Preferred over the flat address when present. Normalized like address.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: The optional second line of the owner's structured postal address. Normalized like address and, when present, appended to addressLine1 (single space) to form the composed address.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Unit 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. Stored and returned in E.164 form.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^\+?[0-9 ()\-]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: The 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. Optional. When supplied it must be valid for the city's region via a fixed table (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          minLength: 4
          maxLength: 4
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered. Defaults to the server's current date when not supplied. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The date of birth of the pet owner. Optional. When supplied, drives the derived ageBand, which is computed as the owner's age on the registrationDate. ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allow creating this owner even if another owner is already in the same household (the same last name and postcode). It only bypasses the duplicate block — the shared householdId is assigned automatically and deterministically regardless of this flag. A declared household member created this way is not flagged as a possible duplicate. Request-only override; never returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.

              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: The owner's salutation, formatted as the title, a single space, then the lastName when a title was supplied; otherwise just the lastName.
              type: string
              example: 'DR who'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans as the country code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes. The raw telephone stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: The owner's customer code formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>' where REGION is the region code derived from the owner's postcode and HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex characters of the SHA-256 digest over the normalized (E.164) telephone concatenated with the lastName. A stable identity carrying no sequence number.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: The Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits of the customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 5
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: The fiscal year of the business-day-adjusted registrationDate, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the fiscal year. The fiscal year starts on 1 July and is named by the calendar year in which it ends (so a registrationDate on or after 1 July belongs to the next calendar year's fiscal year). Absent when there is no registrationDate.
              type: string
              example: 'FY27'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: The owner's membership number formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the fiscal year of the registrationDate (the fiscal year starts on 1 July). Derived from the owner's customerCode and registrationDate.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M27'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A stable identifier for the owner's household, computed deterministically as the first 12 hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized last name and the postcode. Owners with the same last name and postcode share it automatically, regardless of creation order. Absent for owners with no postcode.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: The single derived duplicate-detection key, the full lower-case SHA-256 hex digest over 'normalizedTelephone|lowerEmail|soundex(lastName)' (the email is empty when absent). Creation is rejected with 409 only when a new owner's whole identityKey equals an existing (non-deleted) owner's.
              type: string
              example: '9f86d081884c7d659a2feaa0c55ad015a3bf4f1b2b0b822cd15d6c15b0f00a08'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners (before this owner was created) sharing the same firstName and lastName, compared case-insensitively.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: The owner's membership points. Starts at 0, gains 2 when an email is present, gains 1 when namesakeCount is 0, gains 2 for a household of three or more members, and gains 3 for a tenure of more than one elapsed fiscal year (the fiscal year starts on 1 July).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The owner's numeric membership level, from 1 to 4, derived from membershipPoints - level 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3 points, 3 for 4-5 points and 4 for 6 or more points.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The canonical region for the owner, taken from the REGION component of the customerCode (the '<REGION>-<HASH8>' identity), i.e. the region derived from the owner's postcode, or 'UNKNOWN' when no region applies.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: The IANA timezone for the owner's locality, from the fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the locality has no mapped timezone (i.e. 'UNKNOWN').
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners share this owner's registration date (i.e. more than 80 owners were created for that business day), otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: True when this owner is not a hard duplicate (its identityKey differs) but shares an existing (other, non-deleted) owner's Soundex last name and postcode, otherwise false. A soft-match warning; such an owner is still created.
              type: boolean

              enum:

              example: EMAIL
